title: 第33课 · 他汉语说得很流利
subtitle: Lesson 33 — 他汉语说得很流利 · He speaks Chinese very fluently

Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn liúlì.
Tā chàng gē chàng de fēicháng hǎo.
Nǐ pǎo de kuài bu kuài?
Tā xiě Hànzì xiě de hěn piàoliang.
Nǐ shuì de hǎo bu hǎo?
Wǒ shuì de bú tài hǎo.

items.zh: 玛丽：大卫的汉语说得真流利。
items.py: Mǎlì: Dàwèi de Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn liúlì.
items.en: Mary: David speaks Chinese really fluently.

items.zh: 和子：是啊，他的发音也很标准。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì a, tā de fāyīn yě hěn biāozhǔn.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, his pronunciation is very standard too.

items.zh: 玛丽：他每天都练习说汉语。
items.py: Mǎlì: Tā měi tiān dōu liànxí shuō Hànyǔ.
items.en: Mary: He practices speaking Chinese every day.

items.zh: 和子：怪不得他说得那么好。你呢？
items.py: Hézǐ: Guàibude tā shuō de nàme hǎo. Nǐ ne?
items.en: Hezi: No wonder he speaks so well. And you?

items.zh: 玛丽：我说得不太好，可是写得还可以。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ shuō de bú tài hǎo, kěshì xiě de hái kěyǐ.
items.en: Mary: I don't speak well, but I write OK.

items.zh: 和子：我的听力不错，但是写汉字写得不好。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ de tīnglì búcuò, dànshì xiě Hànzì xiě de bù hǎo.
items.en: Hezi: My listening is good, but I don't write characters well.

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，你昨天睡得好不好？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, nǐ zuótiān shuì de hǎo bu hǎo?
items.en: Liu Jing: David, did you sleep well yesterday?

items.zh: 大卫：睡得不太好，邻居放音乐放得太大声了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Shuì de bú tài hǎo, línjū fàng yīnyuè fàng de tài dà shēng le.
items.en: David: Not well, my neighbor played music too loudly.

items.zh: 刘京：那你今天一定很累。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà nǐ jīntiān yīdìng hěn lèi.
items.en: Liu Jing: You must be tired today then.

items.zh: 大卫：是啊。我今天早上来得也很晚。
items.py: Dàwèi: Shì a. Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang lái de yě hěn wǎn.
items.en: David: Yes. I also came very late this morning.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ chī zǎofàn le ma?
items.en: Liu Jing: Did you have breakfast?

items.py: Dàwèi: Méiyǒu, qǐ de tài wǎn le.
items.en: David: No, I got up too late.

items.en: He speaks very fluently. (V + 得 + adj)

items.en: She dances very well. (VO + V + 得 + adj)

items.py: Tā shuō de bù qīngchu.
Nǐ lái de zǎo bu zǎo?

Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn liúlì.

Tā gāngqín tán de búcuò.
Tā zì xiě de hěn piàoliang.

items.zh: 你跑得快不快？——跑得很快。
items.py: Nǐ pǎo de kuài bu kuài? —— Pǎo de hěn kuài.
items.en: Do you run fast? — Very fast.

items.zh: 你起得早不早？——起得很早。
items.py: Nǐ qǐ de zǎo bu zǎo? —— Qǐ de hěn zǎo.
items.en: Do you get up early? — Very early.
